Name: Content Patcher Animations
Author: spacechase0
TagLine: Animate textures in Content Patcher with its "EditImage" action.
Description:
**Content Patcher Animations** lets you animate textures in Content Patcher with its [font=Courier New]EditImage[/font] action.

**Install**

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io) and [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915).

2.  Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
**Use**
**For players**
Just install the mod and it'll work automatically for content packs that use it.

**For mod authors**

1.  Create a content pack for [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915).

2.  Add an [font=Courier New]EditImage[/font] patch for the image you want to animate.

3.  Give the patch a unique [font=Courier New]LogName[/font] value.

4.  Add these two fields to your patch:

    *   [font=Courier New]AnimationFrameTime[/font] is the number of ticks between each frame (in game ticks, which is 1/60thof a second);

    *   [font=Courier New]AnimationFrameCount[/font] is the number of frames.
All frames must be next to each other horizontally in the same [font=Courier New]FromFile[/font] image.

See the optional files for an example content pack.

**Compatibility**
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

*   [Release notes](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/ContentPatcherAnimations/docs/release-notes.md#release-notes)

*   [Source code](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods)
